name: 实现 DeploymentService (part 1)
description:
实现 DeploymentService 服务方法: createDeployment, getDeployment, listDeployments
  - createDeployment: (request: CreateDeploymentRequest, actor: String) -> CreateDeploymentResponse pre=project_id 对应的项目存在且未软删除；environment_id 对应的环境存在且状态为 online；该 
  - getDeployment: (deploymentId: UUID) -> DeploymentDetailResponse pre=部署记录存在且未被软删除
  - listDeployments: (projectId: UUID, page: Integer, pageSize: Integer) -> PaginatedResult pre=page ≥ 1，pageSize ∈ [1, 100]，项目存在

context.lld_path: .cogniforge/wiki/lld/部署引擎服务/lld-部署引擎服务-001.json
context.module_overview: 核心部署编排服务，负责完整的部署流程调度、版本管理、脚本生成和进度推送。接收Web控制台的部署请求，协调密钥管理服务、SSH连接池服务、文件传输服务完成远程部署，通过WebSocket实时推送执行日志。

service_contracts.name: DeploymentService
service_contracts.description: 部署编排核心服务，管理部署任务的创建、异步执行、状态跟踪和日志推送

methods.name: createDeployment
methods.precondition: project_id 对应的项目存在且未软删除；environment_id 对应的环境存在且状态为 online；该 project_id+environment_id 组合当前无 status=pending 或 running 的活跃部署
methods.postcondition: deployments 表新增一条 status=pending 的记录，version 已按 vYYYYMMDD-HHmmss 格式自动生成，异步任务已提交到消息队列等待执行，审计日志已记录触发操作
methods.description: 创建部署任务记录，生成版本号，校验前置条件后提交异步部署任务

exceptions.name: ProjectNotFound
exceptions.trigger: project_id 对应的项目不存在或已软删除

exceptions.name: EnvironmentNotFound
exceptions.trigger: environment_id 对应的环境不存在或已软删除

exceptions.name: EnvironmentOffline
exceptions.trigger: 目标环境的 status 不为 online，无法执行远程部署

exceptions.name: ActiveDeploymentExists
exceptions.trigger: 同一项目-环境对已存在 status=pending 或 running 的部署

exceptions.name: DatabaseException
exceptions.trigger: 数据库写入失败或连接异常

methods.name: getDeployment
methods.precondition: 部署记录存在且未被软删除
methods.postcondition: 返回该部署记录的完整详情，包含所有字段的当前值
methods.description: 根据部署ID查询单条部署记录的详细信息

exceptions.name: DeploymentNotFound
exceptions.trigger: deploymentId 在 deployments 表中不存在

methods.name: listDeployments
methods.signature: (projectId: UUID, page: Integer, pageSize: Integer) -> PaginatedResult
methods.postcondition: 返回按 created_at 降序排列的部署历史分页数据，包含总记录数
methods.description: 分页查询指定项目的部署历史记录，每条记录携带关联的环境名称

exceptions.name: ProjectNotFound
exceptions.trigger: projectId 对应的项目不存在

exceptions.name: InvalidPagination
exceptions.trigger: page < 1 或 pageSize 不在 [1, 100] 范围内

methods.name: executeDeployment
methods.precondition: 部署记录存在且 status = pending；环境仍处于 online 状态
methods.postcondition: 部署状态依次推进为 running → success/failed。success：远程脚本执行成功（exit_code=0），failed：任意步骤异常。执行过程中逐行记录 deployment_logs，部署完成后更新 log_summary，写入审计日志，清理 Redis 中的实时进度缓存
methods.description: 异步执行业务方法。获取SSH密钥、创建远程部署目录、生成部署脚本、传输文件、远程执行脚本、持续推送日志

exceptions.name: KeyDecryptFailed
exceptions.trigger: 调用密钥管理服务解密私钥时返回错误或连接超时

exceptions.name: SSHConnectionFailed
exceptions.trigger: SSH连接池服务无法建立到目标服务器的连接

exceptions.name: FileTransferFailed
exceptions.trigger: 文件传输服务上传文件到远程服务器失败

exceptions.name: ScriptExecutionFailed
exceptions.trigger: 远程脚本执行返回非零 exit_code

exceptions.name: DirectoryCreationFailed
exceptions.trigger: 在远程服务器创建部署目录失败

methods.name: pushLiveLogs
methods.precondition: 部署记录存在；WebSocket 连接已建立并完成 HTTP 升级握手
methods.postcondition: 先推送部署记录中已有的历史日志定位，然后持续监听 deployment_logs 表新增日志并实时推送。连接关闭或异常时释放资源
methods.description: 通过 WebSocket 连接将部署执行日志实时推送到前端，支持断线重连

exceptions.name: DeploymentNotFound
exceptions.trigger: deploymentId 对应的部署记录不存在

exceptions.name: WebSocketError
exceptions.trigger: WebSocket 连接异常断开或消息序列化失败

repository_dependencies: findDeploymentsByProjectId(projectId: UUID, page: Integer, pageSize: Integer) -> (List<Deployment>, Integer total)
findDeploymentLogsByDeploymentId(deploymentId: UUID, cursor: Long, limit: Integer) -> List<DeploymentLog>
